gloss: to rewrite; to renew; to update

definitions.gloss: to rewrite; to write over again
definitions.explanation: to write something again, replacing the original content
to issue a new version of an official document

examples.japanese: {文章|ぶんしょう}を{書|か}き{換|か}えた。
{下書|したが}きを{何度|なんど}も{書|か}き{換|か}えた。
examples.english: I rewrote the draft many times.

examples.japanese: {歴史|れきし}を{書|か}き{換|か}える{大発見|だいはっけん}だ。
examples.english: It's a discovery that will rewrite history.

examples.japanese: {免許証|めんきょしょう}を{書|か}き{換|か}える。
{パスポート|ぱすぽーと}を{書|か}き{換|か}えなければならない。
examples.english: I have to renew my passport.

examples.japanese: {契約書|けいやくしょ}を{書|か}き{換|か}える{手続|てつづ}きをした。
examples.english: I completed the procedure to renew the contract.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive ({他動詞|たどうし})

USAGE:
- 〜を{書|か}き{換|か}える (to rewrite/renew ~)

FOR DOCUMENTS:
When renewing official documents, {書|か}き{換|か}える is commonly used:
- {免許|めんきょ}の{書|か}き{換|か}え (license renewal)
- {登録|とうろく}の{書|か}き{換|か}え (registration renewal)

RELATED:
- {書|か}き{直|なお}す (to rewrite - implies fixing/improving)
- {更新|こうしん}する (to renew, update - more formal)
- {置|お}き{換|か}える (to replace)
